design_brief.description: Aluminium-extrusion corner bracket sized to fit within a 28 x 28 x 20 mm envelope, forming an L-shaped right-angle bracket with two perpendicular mounting faces and integrated grub-screw clamping features for secure attachment to extrusion slots.

metadata.description: Aluminium-extrusion inner corner bracket within 28x28x20mm envelope: L-shaped right-angle bracket with two perpendicular mounting faces and two grub-screw clamping holes.

total_length.description: Primary size anchor; corresponds to envelope_x and envelope_y.

envelope_x.description: Overall X size; kept equal to total_length.

envelope_y.description: Overall Y size; kept equal to total_length.

internal_corner_radius.description: Approx internal corner relief radius (implemented as a cylindrical cut).

external_edge_chamfer.description: Not explicitly modeled (kept boxy for render safety).

grub_screw_count.description: Two clamping grub screws as shown.

grub_screw_hole_depth.description: Depth of each grub screw hole into the leg.

grub_screw_axis_offset_from_edges.description: Offset of hole axis from the outer edges along the leg.

grub_screw_boss_diameter.description: Boss diameter around each grub screw hole.

grub_screw_boss_height.description: Boss protrusion height on the outside of the leg.

overlap.description: Small overlap to guarantee solid connectivity.

sketch.prompt:
Draw a clean, minimalistic orthographic technical line sketch of the described object on a white background. Use thin black lines only — no shading, no color, no photorealism, no perspective distortion. Keep proportions realistic. Show the front or three-quarter view that most clearly reveals all canonical parts of the object. If helpful, label key dimensions in millimeters with small arrows, but keep labels sparse. The sketch should look like a designer's concept drawing, suitable as a reference for a parametric CAD model.

OBJECT: An aluminium-extrusion corner bracket with an envelope of 28 mm x 28 mm x 20 mm, featuring grub screws for secure attachment.
REQUIRED PARTS (must be visible in the sketch): l_bracket_body, perpendicular_mounting_legs, extrusion, corner, extrusion_corner_bracket, extrusion_corner_bracket_3D, extrusion_inner_corner_bracket
PROPORTIONAL CONSTRAINTS — total_length = 28mm (category: bracket).
All other parts of the sketch must scale consistently with this total size — no exaggerated wheels, handles, or details.
APPROX DIMENSIONS: envelope_x≈28mm, envelope_y≈28mm, envelope_z≈20mm, leg_thickness≈4mm, base_plate_thickness≈4mm, side_wall_thickness≈4mm
NOTE: Extrusion series/slot geometry is unspecified; grub-screw placement is parameterized and should be adjusted to match the target extrusion slot location and wall thickness. Thread is specified nominally as M4; modeling may represent tapped holes as pilot holes if thread geometry is not required.

Keep the final image below 1024x1024, clean white background, no text outside the dimension labels, no watermark.
